designationHistory.name: Delta Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 7229 reserving about 8,000 acres in Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana, near the mouth of the Mississippi River, as a refuge for migratory waterfowl.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Delta National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8517, August 16, 1940 (APP).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Delta and Breton NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2008 (ServCat 168208)
